# Exotic Nutrition

> Exotic Nutrition is a comprehensive online retailer specializing in nutritionally complete foods, live insects, cages, and accessories for exotic pets and small animals.

The site serves exotic pet owners across multiple species categories including sugar gliders, squirrels, hedgehogs, chinchillas, hamsters, gerbils, and backyard chickens. They offer premium branded products like Premium Squirrel Blocks, Berry Bites, and the expandable Borneo Cage, with fast shipping via USPS, UPS, and FedEx.

## Pet Food & Nutrition

- [Foods](https://exoticnutrition.com/collections/food): Exotic pet food collection with kibble, pellets for multiple species
- [Premium Squirrel Blocks—Apple Flavor](http://exoticnutrition.com/products/squirrel-blocks): Premium Squirrel Blocks nutritionally complete diet for all squirrel life stages
- [Berry Bites](https://exoticnutrition.com/collections/new-product-releases/products/berry-bites): Berry Bites supplemental treats for Sugar Gliders and Marmosets with calcium
- [Mealworms & Insects](https://exoticnutrition.com/collections/mealworms-insects): Live Mealworms in multiple sizes with fast shipping for reptile food

## Species-Specific Product Collections

- [Squirrel Products](https://exoticnutrition.com/collections/squirrel-products): Squirrel product collection including blocks and complete diet formulas
- [Sugar Glider Products](https://exoticnutrition.com/collections/sugar-glider-products): Sugar Glider product collection including cages and pet supplies
- [Hedgehog Products](https://exoticnutrition.com/collections/hedgehog-products): Hedgehog product collection with cages, food, wheels, starter packs
- [Chinchilla Products](https://exoticnutrition.com/collections/chinchilla-products): Chinchilla product collection with cages, mansion habitats, supplies
- [Hamster & Gerbil Products](https://exoticnutrition.com/collections/hamster-gerbil-products): Hamster and Gerbil products including wheels, treats, cages
- [Backyard Chicken Products](https://exoticnutrition.com/collections/backyard-chicken-products): Backyard Chicken feed supplements with dried insects and mealworms
- [Wild Bird Products](https://exoticnutrition.com/collections/wild-bird-products): Wild Bird feed including dried mealworms for bluebirds and songbirds

## Cages & Housing

- [Borneo Cage](https://exoticnutrition.com/collections/cages/products/new-borneo-cage): Borneo Cage Version II expandable housing with 38 cubic feet space
